Thank you all for your reports. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and identify the key conditions before I make my decision:

1. Process Engineering (Ravi): The alternate resin can be blended at exactly 30% alternate / 70% standard resin, and the first 100 housings must pass tensile testing before the run continues. However, this trial result has not yet been entered in the production traveler.

2. Materials Logistics (Marta): Exactly four sealed gaylords containing 2,400 kg of alternate resin will arrive Wednesday at 09:00. The delivery confirmation has not yet been added to the material schedule.

3. Customer Compliance (Jonas): Customer approval is required before any alternate-resin housings can ship, covering at most the first 1,000 housings, with serialized material-lot traceability required. The review has not yet been attached to the customer order.

Before I issue my decision, I need commitments from each of you on the open items. Ravi, can you commit to entering the trial result in the production traveler before the run begins? Marta, can you commit to adding the delivery confirmation to the material schedule? And Jonas, can you commit to attaching the compliance review to the customer order and initiating the customer approval process? I want all documentation gaps closed before we proceed.
